overview: AUTOPLAY generates diverse and verifiable tasks for training UI agents by first exploring interactive environments via a memory-augmented MLLM and then synthesizing tasks using exploration trajectories and domain-specific guidelines, which enables scalable supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

modules.name: Environment Abstraction & Controller
modules.description: Wraps mobile and computer platforms into a unified Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) interface, managing state initialization, screenshot observation retrieval, and low-level UI action execution.

modules.name: Low-Level Action Grounding
modules.description: Translates high-level natural language action intents into precise pixel-level coordinates using specialized grounding models, supporting interactions like clicks, types, and scrolls on UI elements.

modules.name: Explorer Memory & Summarization
modules.description: Manages episodic memory for the exploration agent by storing past trajectories and using an MLLM summarizer to condense them into structured text representations of functionalities and data.

modules.name: Autonomous Environment Explorer
modules.description: Implements the Stage 1 exploration logic, repeatedly sampling trajectories using the MLLM explorer to maximize coverage over novel states and functionalities across multiple exploration turns.

modules.name: Task Guideline Manager
modules.description: Stores and manages domain-specific task guideline prompts (e.g., Feature-Use, Feature-Composition, Information Retrieval) that enforce task diversity, verifiability, and domain relevance.

modules.name: Context-Aware Task Generator
modules.description: Implements the Stage 2 task synthesis logic, combining the exploration trajectory context with sampled task guidelines to prompt an MLLM for generating environment-grounded task instructions.

modules.name: Trajectory Execution Agent
modules.description: Implements the high-level planner with a reflection tool used to execute proposed tasks, generating step-by-step action plans and analyzing transitions to collect demonstration data.

modules.name: Trajectory Verifier
modules.description: Implements an MLLM-based verification module that evaluates task execution success using Chain-of-Thought reasoning over the trajectory's observations and actions, without privileged environment access.

modules.name: Dataset Construction Pipeline
modules.description: Filters executed trajectories based on verifier judgments, pairs successful trajectories with their corresponding task instructions, and formats them into standardized datasets for downstream training.

modules.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning Engine
modules.description: Implements the training loop for fine-tuning the base MLLM on the verified trajectory dataset, updating the policy to map visual observations and task instructions directly to UI actions.

modules.name: Reinforcement Learning Engine
modules.description: Implements the reinforcement learning loop using the GRPO algorithm, sampling tasks from the generated dataset and using the verifier's binary judgment as a sparse reward signal to further optimize the agent.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates the evaluation of trained agents on standardized mobile (AndroidWorld) and computer (OSWorld) benchmarks, handling state resets and interaction loops under ground-truth verifiers.

modules.name: Performance Metrics Calculator
modules.description: Computes Pass@1 and Pass@5 success rate metrics over multiple independent stochastic trials, and evaluates statistical significance and generalization capabilities to holdout applications.

modules.name: Task Coverage & Diversity Analyzer
modules.description: Categorizes generated tasks into predefined skill categories using an LLM, and computes distribution statistics to compare task diversity and coverage against natural benchmarks and baselines.

modules.name: Baseline & Ablation Implementations
modules.description: Implements comparison methods such as the 'No Exploration' (static description-based) and 'Iterative Exploration' (hindsight relabeling) task generators, as well as guideline ablation variants.
